critic.fix_suggestion: Separate the engine geometry from the wing/fuselage junction by creating two distinct pylon primitives for each side. Position these pylons along the leading edge of the swept wing, extending outward and forward from the wing root. Each pylon should be scaled to a length-to-width ratio of 4:1, with engines mounted at the distal end of the pylons rather than directly against the fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: Two engines visible on the starboard wing
Engines are positioned close to the fuselage/wing root
discrepancies.reference: Engines are spaced out along the leading edge of the swept wing

discrepancies.observed: Wings appear relatively straight with minimal backward angle
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: rotate wing geometry backward along the longitudinal axis

discrepancies.observed: Engines are attached directly to the underside of the fuselage/wing junction
discrepancies.reference: Engines are mounted on distinct pylons extending from the wing
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: attach engines to separate pylon geometries
